title: LDU-W Definition (Workable Definition Universe)
description: Schema for Local Workable Definition Universe - scoped, immutable interpretations derived from LDU-T raw data

id.description: Unique identifier for this LDU-W definition. Must start with 'ldu_w_' and use lowercase alphanumeric + underscores.

universe.description: MUST be exactly 'LDU-W'. Enforces layer separation.

term.description: The term being defined. Lowercase alphanumeric + underscores only. Primary key for scoped lookups.

claim.description: The workable interpretation/definition (not authority-backed, local scope only)

text.description: The actual definition text for this term in the given scope.

confidence.description: Optional: confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) from derivation process.

source_ldu_t_ids.description: REQUIRED: Array of LDU-T entry IDs this definition is derived from. Must not be empty. Provides traceable lineage to raw data.

gdu_shape.description: Explicit declaration of what GDU structure this definition targets/conforms to.

structure.description: Type of GDU structure this definition targets.

version.description: GDU shape version (e.g., '1.0', '1.1'). Helps track conformance expectations.

scope.description: REQUIRED: Explicit scope declaration. All fields must be non-empty strings.

culture.description: Cultural/linguistic context (e.g., 'US English', 'UK English', 'ISO standard', 'technical jargon').

derivation_method.description: How was this definition created? (e.g., 'semantic_analysis_v1.0', 'expert_review_v2.0', 'community_consensus'). Must be version-specific.

status.description: Review status (mutable). draft → reviewed → ready_for_promotion (promotion ceremony next).

metadata.description: Optional mutable metadata (tags, notes, review feedback). Does not affect definition semantics.

version.description: Version counter (incremented on metadata/status changes). Tracks audit history.

created_at.description: When was this definition created? ISO-8601, system clock.

updated_at.description: When was this definition last updated? ISO-8601, system clock.

tenant_id.description: Multi-tenancy support: which tenant owns this definition?
